iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

HTTP_DISABLED
       Triggered when HTTP is disabled.

DESCRIPTION
       Triggers when HTTP is disabled.

Examples
	when HTTP_DISABLED {
	  log local0. "Passthru reason: [HTTP::passthrough_reason]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
